name: Jay Ushin Limited
about: Jay Ushin Limited engages in the manufacture, purchase, and sale of lock and key sets, door latches, heater control panels (HVAC), and switches for automobiles in India and internationally. The company provides heater control panel, lockset two and four wheelers, door latches, combination switches, car accessories, handlebars, fuel level gauge, CNG cylinders, lithium battery, instrument cluster two and four wheelers, and speed sensors. It also offers dies, jigs, fixtures, molds, machine tools, cutting tools, and gauges; electronics and energy products, such as energy meters, batteries, sponge iron, and solar panels, as well as surface mount technology; and LED bulbs and lights. In addition, the company provides moulding, plastic moulds, moulds and tools, painted parts, and laser marking. Jay Ushin Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in New Delhi, India. Jay Ushin Limited operates as a subsidiary of MINEBEA MITSUMI Inc.
